messages:
sara: Heads-up — I ran the sample-mix bakeoff for redwood-3b-mix across FP8 / INT8-GPTQ / AWQ / FP16 baseline. Short summary first: FP8 looks promising latency/cost-wise, AWQ has the largest accuracy delta on instruction-following tests, GPTQ-INT8 is somewhere in the middle.
omar: Nice. Can you paste the deltas and the perf numbers? rough numbers OK.
sara: Sure, pasted below. This is the compact eval from the goldenset + long-tail fuzz queries.

eval-bot: SUMMARY: model=redwood-3b-mix | dataset=goldenset+samplemix | baseline=fp16 | metrics={instr_score, helpfulness, exact_match} | n=4500

sara: FP16 (baseline): instr_score=0.842, latency=210ms @1rps
FP8: instr_score=0.834 (-0.008), latency=150ms (-28%), cost_est=~0.42x
GPTQ-INT8: instr_score=0.828 (-0.014), latency=165ms (-21%), cost_est=~0.48x
AWQ-INT8: instr_score=0.814 (-0.028), latency=160ms (-24%), cost_est=~0.46x

sara: Notes: AWQ failures skew on multi-step chain-of-thought and long code blocks — we saw hallucination cases and truncation-related scoring hits. FP8 mainly loses a tiny amount on exact_match for numeric outputs.
li: Do we have per-route breakdown? hosted vs dedicated differences?
sara: Yes — hosted (vCPU front + GPU pool) saw slightly higher tail latency for AWQ on long prompts because of serialization in the current runtime path. Dedicated (reserved GPU) had more consistent latency but the same accuracy deltas.

ben: Thinking about rollout: propose canary plan
- hosted: start 0.5% traffic FP8 for 24h, escalate to 5% if no regression
- dedicated: stage 1% (internal customers) then 10% after 48h
- private: require customer opt-in + eval pass
fallback: automatic fallback to `fp16` if instr_score drop > 1.5% or error-rate + latency spikes over SLO

omar: Can we express that as a rollout config? I want it in the deploy system.
sara: yup, quick draft config (json):
```
{
  "model": "redwood-3b-mix",
  "variants": ["fp16","fp8","gptq-int8","awq-int8"],
  "routes": {
    "hosted": {"canary": 0.005, "watch": 24, "escalate": 0.05},
    "dedicated": {"internal_canary": 0.01, "watch": 48, "escalate": 0.10},
    "private": {"opt_in": true}
  },
  "fallback": {
    "metric": "instr_score",
    "threshold_pct": 1.5,
    "rollback_to": "fp16",
    "auto": true
  }
}
```
li: Two asks: (1) add latency SLO triggers (p95 > 350ms) to fallback; (2) include goldenset quick smoke every 15m during canary.
ben: Agreed. Also add KV-cache warmup check — we saw some cache misses for AWQ in hosted that inflated tail latency.
sara: I'll update.

eval-bot: QUICK_SMOKE: awq-int8 | goldenset_small | instr_score_drop=2.1% | flagged
omar: Flagged AWQ on hosted then. Do not start canary for AWQ on hosted until we mitigate cache warmup.
sara: Plan: disable AWQ in hosted pool, run deeper quant-sweep (per-layer range refinement) and re-eval on 10k samplemix. If that passes (instr_score_drop < 1.0% and p95 < 320ms) we can try hosted canary at 0.1%.
ben: For Dedicated customers, we can offer AWQ as experimental opt-in with explicit risk note.
li: Add alerting: pager if fallback triggers on >0.5% traffic or repeated rollbacks.

omar: One more operational note — ensure deploy-bot sets metadata `quant_profile=awq-v1` and `golden_hash=2026-03-18` on rollout so we can trace back.
sara: Good call.

ben: Action items:
- sara: run 10k sweep for AWQ and upload new eval by EOD + update rollout JSON
- omar: add latency SLO and KV-cache warmup probe to the router rules
- li: add pager/alert thresholds
- product: prepare external-facing note for dedicated/private customers

sara: I'll post the updated numbers and new eval artifact here when done. Thanks :thumbsup:
omar: thx
li: appreciated :eyes:
eval-bot: ARTIFACT_UPLOADED: s3://redwood-evals/redwood-3b-mix/awq-sweep-2026-03-18-1948201010.json"
